requirements.topic: 固定赛程目标与随机回归总体
requirements.existing_evidence: 研究/04_共同可靠性/第一步_推断对象与固定条件.md
requirements.MG: 原A*Y和固定D/q不变；条件集合独立下界直接对应T=A*p，无回归总体替换。
requirements.MP: A*Y不变，模型仅校准其分布；oracle对应同目标，但估计参数替换无现成有限保证。
requirements.facts_vs_assumptions: Original schedule facts checked in step2; mechanism/model claims remain conditional assumptions

requirements.topic: 共享成员及跨主客角色
requirements.MG: 图边纳入任一角色共享队，着色禁止同队重现；容许图内任意正负相关。
requirements.MP: 两个球队过程分别以主减客及主加客载荷表达正负模式；额外对子项，是否足够仍为模型限制。
requirements.facts_vs_assumptions: Original schedule facts checked in step2; mechanism/model claims remain conditional assumptions

requirements.topic: 共同时间及真实赛事届次
requirements.MG: 日期差<=L连边而非按年分割，同日必相连；有限L后的联合独立未获事实认证。
requirements.MP: 不等间隔OU递推，同日复用状态；长尾可跨年。没有真实届次，C16人工赛事群检验遗漏风险。
requirements.facts_vs_assumptions: Original schedule facts checked in step2; mechanism/model claims remain conditional assumptions

requirements.topic: 不均衡、增长单位与小局部群
requirements.MG: 有限样本证明不要求多球队；小群/大权重会放大界或只剩逻辑范围。
requirements.MP: 参数估计可能在少群/稀有球队失败；不得借全局样本量担保，完整外层拟合和失败率验收待做。
requirements.facts_vs_assumptions: Original schedule facts checked in step2; mechanism/model claims remain conditional assumptions

requirements.topic: 异质主胜概率和干扰均值
requirements.MG: 允许任意p_i，无需层均值残差；有界变量指数矩直接适配。
requirements.MP: 规定回顾性logistic均值和Gaussian copula；遗漏球队×年代等用C12压力检验，不声明均值模型为事实。
requirements.facts_vs_assumptions: Original schedule facts checked in step2; mechanism/model claims remain conditional assumptions

requirements.topic: 缺层、稀疏和单场大权重
requirements.MG: 正参考缺层仍null，单场大系数合法但宽；不以n门槛删层。
requirements.MP: 不新增缺层比赛，概率边界/低样本可能破坏拟合和plugin校准；仅作为开发候选。
requirements.facts_vs_assumptions: Original schedule facts checked in step2; mechanism/model claims remain conditional assumptions

requirements.MG: 并集界保证原家族条件同时覆盖，无逆矩阵；各L是不同假设，无198项无条件总保证。
requirements.MP: 同一Y_star在原全家族max校准，设计尺度不是SE；不会倒置奇异协方差；已知参数和拟合参数的保证分开。
requirements.facts_vs_assumptions: Original schedule facts checked in step2; mechanism/model claims remain conditional assumptions

requirements.MG: 同一逐场向量系数与图，不将窗口独立化。
requirements.MP: 每轮生成一份全赛程结果共享36窗和其他目标，窗内q固定。
requirements.facts_vs_assumptions: Original schedule facts checked in step2; mechanism/model claims remain conditional assumptions

requirements.topic: 档案质量、会员、历史身份与未知地理
requirements.MG: 事实/身份错误不在统计界内，原117和未知去向沿用。
requirements.MP: 同样不修复档案错误或随机缺失，未来预测不在范围。
requirements.facts_vs_assumptions: Original schedule facts checked in step2; mechanism/model claims remain conditional assumptions

requirements.MG: 着色/系数只依设计，不抽国家或改变q。
requirements.MP: 固定原赛程造二元结果，不造新赛程；换q或条件人群留独立敏感性。
requirements.facts_vs_assumptions: Original schedule facts checked in step2; mechanism/model claims remain conditional assumptions

requirements.topic: 网络可观测不等于外生
requirements.MG: 声明的是给定D的联合独立关系图，不声称实际交手网络外生。
requirements.MP: 指定独立潜在因素工作模型，不借P03外生网络定理；实际排赛选择可能使模型不符。
requirements.facts_vs_assumptions: Original schedule facts checked in step2; mechanism/model claims remain conditional assumptions

requirements.MG: 全零系数恒0，逻辑裁剪，图验证失败就报错，无PSD估计/近似要求。
requirements.MP: 线性潜在构造保证PSD但不保证拟合识别；边界、概率剪裁、多起点、超时都留失败状态。
requirements.facts_vs_assumptions: Original schedule facts checked in step2; mechanism/model claims remain conditional assumptions

requirements.MG: 全依赖下本界必为全逻辑范围，标无信息，不称高精度或无差异。
requirements.MP: 报告宽度/无信息率，无等效性界限不作无作用结论。
requirements.facts_vs_assumptions: Original schedule facts checked in step2; mechanism/model claims remain conditional assumptions

requirements.MG: 依赖范围集合事先固定，不按赛果挑更窄图，旧目录不变。
requirements.MP: 均值/关联族、惩罚/参数范围和筛选在模拟前固定，不按真实p值选模型。
requirements.facts_vs_assumptions: Original schedule facts checked in step2; mechanism/model claims remain conditional assumptions

screening.reason: shared teams/time, heterogeneous cells and simultaneous scope not handled
fixed-mean residual-centering bias and potentially indefinite mask; common-time and asymptotic regime unresolved; exact finite counterexample is not a disproof of original theory

screening.family: current row bootstrap or resampling countries
screening.reason: row version destroys dependence; country version changes conditional design/target; not a universal rejection of valid specialized dependence bootstrap
no randomization or exchangeability argument for these fixed labels
required exogenous network and decay/growth transfer unavailable

screening.family: marginal binary Gaussian copula and parametric bootstrap
screening.reason: coherent heterogeneous binary model and oracle root calibration; actual fitting/identification/plugin coverage and budget unvalidated
finite conditional bound handles heterogeneous means/signs/small groups, but requires declared setwise independence and may be uninformative

MG: shared-team-only graph misses time; add fixed calendar-range alternatives
ordinary K bound refined by design-weighted Holder constant
pointwise bound extended by union bound to unchanged families and logical clipping
no finite range certified true; all-dependent case retained and proved uninformative at nominal95%
MP: independent layer Bernoulli rejected; replace by marginal/association separation
arbitrary correlation table rejected; latent PSD construction and irregular-date OU recursion
homogeneous role effects extended to plus/minus team processes, pair and common time
observed point statistic kept A*Y; model mean used only to center reference root
oracle finite-rank proof separated from estimated-parameter plugin gap; explicit refitting/coverage/budget gates
